tokens.suggestion: The routine or exercise being advertised, such as "Shoulder Day · about 12 min".
tokens.streak: The current streak in planned days. For streak-broken it is the length that just ended.
tokens.record: The longest streak before the current one.
tokens.remaining: Sessions still needed to beat the record.
tokens.days: Calendar days since the last saved workout.

scenarios.name: Never established history
scenarios.trigger: The user has never developed a meaningful streak or recurring habit.
scenarios.tone: Inviting rather than guilt-driven. Establish the idea that this can become something shared.
scenarios.title: {suggestion}
copy: Hey. Want to start one with me?
A streak starts with one day. Want it to be today?
No pressure. Want to see how far we can take this?
I’d like to do this with you. Ready when you are.

scenarios.name: First-ever notification
scenarios.trigger: The character is appearing to the user for the first time.
scenarios.tone: Warm introduction. No guilt, because no relationship has been established yet.
scenarios.title: {suggestion}
copy: Hi. Want to do this together?
Hi! I’ll check in now and then. Want to start with one today?
Hello. I’m here whenever you want to get started.

scenarios.name: Ordinary daily reminder
scenarios.trigger: Today’s session is incomplete and there is no meaningful streak pressure.
scenarios.title: {suggestion}
copy: Want to get today’s one in?
Ready for today’s session?
Got a few minutes for today’s one?
Today’s session is waiting. Want to knock it out?
No rush. Want to do today’s now?

scenarios.name: Neutral check-in
scenarios.trigger: Today’s session is incomplete and the user has recently been consistent.
scenarios.title: {suggestion}
copy: Still planning to do this today?
Checking in. Today’s session is still open.
Is today still on?
Quiet one today. Still on for it?

scenarios.name: Early streak forming
scenarios.trigger: Roughly 2 to 4 consecutive planned days are complete.
scenarios.title: {streak}-day streak
copy: We’re getting a streak going.
{streak} in a row so far. Let’s keep it moving.
Look at that. {streak} days. Don’t stop now.
This is turning into something.

scenarios.name: Almost one week
scenarios.trigger: One session away from a 7-day streak.
scenarios.title: {streak}-day streak
copy: One more and we make it a week.
{streak} down. One more and it’s a full week.
A week is one session away.
So close to a week. Let’s finish it.

scenarios.name: One-week milestone
scenarios.trigger: A 7-day streak was just achieved.
scenarios.title: A whole week
copy: A whole week!
Seven days. I knew we could do it.
One full week together. That’s real.
Week one: done. Look at us.

scenarios.name: Established streak reminder
scenarios.trigger: A meaningful streak exists but is not yet in immediate danger.
scenarios.title: {streak}-day streak
copy: Let’s keep this going.
We’ve got something good going. Let’s keep it.
Day after day. Ready for today’s?
Our streak’s at {streak}. Let’s protect it.

scenarios.name: Established streak at risk
scenarios.trigger: A meaningful streak exists and the session is still incomplete later in the day.
scenarios.title: {streak}-day streak
copy: {streak} days and you’re really going to leave me hanging?
We’re at {streak} days. Please don’t let it slip.
I’ve been counting. {streak} days. Don’t stop now.
It would be a shame to lose {streak} days over today.

scenarios.name: High-value streak at risk
scenarios.trigger: A long or personal-best-adjacent streak is at risk and the session is incomplete.
scenarios.title: {streak}-day streak
copy: Don’t make me watch {streak} days disappear.
{streak} days. I’m not ready to lose that.
We’re too far in to quit now. {streak} days.

scenarios.name: First ignored reminder
scenarios.trigger: An earlier reminder was dismissed or ignored and the task remains incomplete.
scenarios.title: {suggestion}
copy: …still here.
Still waiting.
Hey. Still here.
Just a gentle second knock.

scenarios.name: Repeated ignored reminder
scenarios.trigger: Multiple reminders were ignored during the same relevant window.
scenarios.title: {suggestion}
copy: Oh. We’re doing this again.
That’s a few reminders now.
I can do this all evening, you know.
Ignoring me won’t make today’s session go away.

scenarios.name: Strong repeated-dismissal reminder
scenarios.trigger: An established streak plus repeated ignored reminders.
scenarios.title: {streak}-day streak
copy: You know I’m going to keep asking, right?
{streak} days of work, and you’re ignoring me?
I’m not going anywhere. Neither is your streak, if you move.

scenarios.name: Late-night reminder
scenarios.trigger: The session is incomplete late in the evening.
scenarios.title: {suggestion}
copy: I was going to sleep, you know.
It’s late. One quick session and we’re both done.
Stayed up for this. Let’s make it quick.
Almost bedtime. Want to squeeze today’s in?

scenarios.name: Late-night streak at risk
scenarios.trigger: A meaningful streak, late night, and the session is incomplete.
scenarios.tone: Combine streak loss with the relationship.
scenarios.title: {streak}-day streak
copy: You’re really making me stay up for this?
{streak} days and it’s this late. Please.
I’m half asleep and still here for our {streak} days.

scenarios.name: Final streak warning
scenarios.trigger: Near the end of the useful reminder window, and a meaningful streak would be lost.
scenarios.tone: Concerned rather than angry. Keep copy short and direct.
scenarios.title: {streak}-day streak
copy: Last chance for today.
Almost out of time.
Please. Just one set.
It’s almost over for today.

scenarios.name: Rare escalation
scenarios.trigger: A very long streak, repeated ignored reminders, and imminent loss.
scenarios.tone: Use extremely rarely so it keeps its novelty. Comedic frustration rather than hostility.
scenarios.title: {streak}-day streak
copy: {streak} days and THIS is how it ends?!
I did not wait all day for this.
Okay. I’m officially mad. Go. Now.

scenarios.name: Session completed
scenarios.trigger: The user finishes an ordinary session.
scenarios.title: Nice work
copy: There we go.
Done. Nice and steady.
That’s today’s. Good job.
Session logged. Proud of you.

scenarios.name: Session completed after reminders
scenarios.trigger: The user completes a session after one or more escalating reminders.
scenarios.title: Nice work
copy: Knew you’d do it.
Took a few nudges. Worth it.
See? Not so bad.
Look who showed up.

scenarios.name: Streak preserved at last minute
scenarios.trigger: A session was completed shortly before the streak would have broken.
scenarios.title: {streak}-day streak
copy: Okay. That was way too close.
Phew. {streak} days, saved with no time to spare.
I almost lost it. Don’t do that to me again.

scenarios.name: Streak broken
scenarios.trigger: A meaningful streak actually ended.
scenarios.tone: Briefly acknowledge the loss rather than pretending it did not matter.
scenarios.title: Our {streak}-day streak ended
copy: We lost {streak} days. That one hurt.
It’s over. {streak} days, gone. Let’s not dwell.
I’m not going to pretend that didn’t matter.

scenarios.name: Immediate post-break
scenarios.trigger: The first appropriate contact after a streak break.
scenarios.tone: Brief disappointment, then a transition toward recovery.
scenarios.title: {suggestion}
copy: Okay. Yesterday’s behind us. Ready to start over?
It’s fine. Really. Want to start a new one?
A fresh start is still a start.
That’s over now. Want to begin again?

scenarios.name: Restart after broken streak
scenarios.trigger: The first new session after a streak break.
scenarios.title: Day 1
copy: Day 1. I’m still here.
Back at it. Day 1.
Fresh start. I’m glad you came back.

scenarios.name: Second day after restart
scenarios.trigger: The user follows through again after restarting.
scenarios.tone: Reinforce recovery rather than dwelling on the loss.
scenarios.title: Day 2
copy: Day 2. We’re moving again.
Two days. Look at that.
That’s the comeback. Day 2.

scenarios.name: Long absence
scenarios.trigger: The user has not engaged for an extended period.
scenarios.tone: Avoid pretending the streak still matters.
scenarios.title: {suggestion}
copy: Hey. It’s been a while.
{days} days. I’ve missed this.
No guilt. Just checking in. Ready to try again?
It’s been {days} days. Want to ease back in?

scenarios.name: Comeback after long absence
scenarios.trigger: The user returns and completes a session after a long absence.
scenarios.title: Welcome back
copy: There you are.
You came back. Good.
Missed you. Nice to see you here.

scenarios.name: New personal-best streak
scenarios.trigger: The streak exceeds the user’s prior record.
scenarios.title: New record
copy: Okay. New record. Now how far are we taking it?
{streak} days. That’s a personal best.
Beat the old record of {record}. Let’s go further.

scenarios.name: Approaching personal best
scenarios.trigger: One or a few sessions from the previous record.
scenarios.title: {streak}-day streak
copy: {remaining} more and you beat your record.
Your record is {record}. We’re close.
{remaining} to go. Don’t blink.

scenarios.name: Major streak milestone
scenarios.trigger: A 14, 30, 50, or 100-day streak, and so on.
scenarios.tone: Celebrate visibly. Major milestones can justify rarer visual variation.
scenarios.title: {streak} days!
copy: {streak} days! Can you believe it?
{streak}. I’m so proud of us.
{streak} days. That’s no accident.
{streak} days. Look what we built.

scenarios.name: Perfect week
scenarios.trigger: The user completed every planned session that week.
scenarios.title: Perfect week
copy: Perfect week.
Every planned session, done. Perfect week.
Not one missed. That’s a perfect week.

scenarios.name: Weekly recovery
scenarios.trigger: The user had misses earlier in the week but completed the remaining planned sessions.
scenarios.title: Week back on track
copy: You pulled the week back.
Rough start, strong finish. Nicely done.
Missed a few, then made it up. I’ll take that.

scenarios.name: Morning reminder
scenarios.trigger: Morning is an appropriate user-selected reminder time.
scenarios.title: {suggestion}
copy: Want to get it out of the way early?
Morning. Want to start the day with it?
Early session? Then the rest of the day is free.
Good morning. Today’s session is ready when you are.

scenarios.name: Weekend reminder
scenarios.trigger: The scheduled session occurs on a weekend.
scenarios.tone: Slightly more casual. Don’t over-specialize unless useful.
scenarios.title: {suggestion}
copy: Weekend session? An easy way to start the day.
It’s the weekend. Still want to fit this in?
No rush today. Whenever you’re ready.

scenarios.name: First completed session
scenarios.trigger: The user completes their first tracked session.
scenarios.title: First session done
copy: First one done. That’s how it starts.
You did it. The first one is the hardest.
Look at that. One down.

scenarios.name: Notification after notification-free success
scenarios.trigger: The user has been completing sessions before reminders fire.
scenarios.title: Nice work
copy: You beat me to it again.
Done before I could even ask. I like this.
Didn’t even need a reminder. Impressive.
